content: PHP include()/require() for header.php/footer.php is the standard zero-build-tool templating pattern for shared PHP hosting: split shared chrome into includes, keep per-page content in .php files, combine via include. Works directly on the server with no build step or Node.js. Caveat: some hosts restrict parsing .html as PHP, so page files should use .php extensions, and include fragments commonly use .inc.php or similar to avoid direct URL access.
